description: Single storey front extension; single and two storey side to rear extension; alterations to roof to raise ridge height and rear dormer; raised patio at rear; gabling to front roof projection; external alterations
decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;</p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">MUCR22 PL-01, MUCR22 PL-02 Rev C, FRA (Revised 03/03/2026), Permeable paving maintenance plan and Mitigation Measures (March 2026), CIL Form 1, Reasonable Exception Statement&nbsp;</span></p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no windows / doors, other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevations of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
